entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for my VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
It's Sarah Miller, order number 951-4B3-2025. Just process the return, please.

Okay, I've got your account here, Sarah. I see you received the VeloBand GPS Tracker about 37 days ago. To follow procedure, I just need to ask: what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not broken, it's just hard to use. The menu is confusing, and frankly I expected more for the price. The user manual wasn't any help either. Can I return it or not?
I understand the frustration. Sometimes it just takes a moment to get used to the controls. For instance, the quick-access menu can be customized if you...
Look, I don't have time for a lesson. It's a simple yes or no question. Am I eligible to return this?
Right, my apologies. Let me check the policy for you right now. One moment.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Your purchase date was December 15th, which puts you at day 37. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days.
So, yes. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file for you right now.

You're welcome. Just place the device and all its accessories back in the original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued. Anything else for you today?
Alright then. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
